1. Sign in as vendor
2. Open /profile
cases.expected: Customer profile loads or role-appropriate view
cases.actual: /profile is customer route; vendor may see customer profile if allowed by layout or empty customer row.

cases.testData: customer with linked vendor credentials after approval
cases.title: Linked vendor credentials box shown when approved vendor linked
cases.steps:
1. Sign in as customer approved as vendor
2. Open /profile
cases.actual: shouldShowLinkedVendorCredentials renders LinkedVendorCredentialsBox when data present.

cases.title: Checkout processes only selected cart items
cases.steps:
1. Open /cart
2. Select subset of items
3. Choose payment method and checkout
cases.expected: Only selected items move to next order status; unselected remain pending
cases.actual: handleCheckout filters by selectedIds; updates order status per vendor order.

cases.title: Online checkout redirects to To Pay orders tab
cases.steps:
1. Select items
2. Choose Online Payment
3. Complete checkout
cases.actual: After checkout window.location.href `/orders?tab=to-pay` for online method.

cases.title: Checkout with no items selected blocked
cases.steps:
1. Open /cart
2. Deselect all
3. Click checkout
cases.actual: handleCheckout returns when selectedIds.size===0.

cases.title: COD checkout redirects to To Ship tab
cases.steps:
1. Select items
2. Choose Cash on Delivery
3. Checkout
cases.actual: Checkout sets nextTab to-ship when paymentMethod is cod.

cases.title: Pay Now opens order payment page for to-pay order
cases.steps:
1. Open /orders?tab=to-pay
2. Click Pay Now
3. Confirm pay page loads
cases.expected: Payment instructions and receipt upload form
cases.actual: CustomerPayOrderPageView loads loadCustomerPayPage; uploadOrderReceiptProof action.

cases.title: Guest cannot open pay page for order
cases.steps:
1. Sign out
2. Open /orders/VALID_ID/pay directly
cases.actual: CustomerPayOrderUnauthenticatedView when loadCustomerPayPage unauthenticated.

cases.title: Another customer orderId on pay page shows not found
cases.steps:
1. Sign in as test@customer.com
2. Open pay URL for another user's order
cases.actual: loadCustomerPayPage returns not-found for non-owned orders.

cases.title: Double checkout click does not duplicate orders
cases.steps:
1. Select items
2. Rapidly double-click checkout
cases.actual: checkoutLoading flag disables button during handleCheckout.

cases.testData: selected item stocks hit 0 before checkout
cases.remarks: Confirm explicit OOS block in handleCheckout.
cases.title: Out-of-stock selected item blocked at checkout
cases.steps:
1. Select item
2. Set product stock to 0 in DB
3. Attempt checkout
cases.actual: Out-of-stock rows marked unavailable; checkout may still attempt if selection includes OOS-verify guard.

cases.remarks: Online gateway simulation not wired; receipt upload is manual.
cases.title: Integrated payment gateway decline handling
cases.steps:
1. Checkout online
2. Simulate gateway decline on pay page
cases.expected: Payment failed message; order stays to-pay
cases.actual: Current flow uses manual receipt upload on pay page; no live payment gateway token decline UI.
